Definition: something perfect, i.e. a splendid garment
BiblicalUsage: The merchants of Tyre traded in all sorts of things, in blue clothes and broidered work and chests of rich apparel, bound with cords and made of cedar. The word is the splendid garment itself, and it stands in the cargo list of the richest city on the sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tyre's rich apparel is the measure of her pride: blue clothes and broidered work in chests of cedar, and the whole cargo going down with the city.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
